subject: Prepaid proration, LoL carve-outs and wind-down assistance — MSA/Order Form
messages:
From: Amit Sharma <amit@nimbushealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Nitya Rao <nitya.rao@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSA & Order Form — Limitation of Liability / Termination questions

Hannah — thanks for the redlines. Our legal team is reviewing and flagged two material issues that will block internal approval unless we agree language: 1) Limitation of liability (LoL) currently caps at $100k and excludes consequential damages entirely. For a healthcare integration with PHI-proximal processing, our counsel wants higher caps and specific carve-outs for breaches. 2) Termination/refund mechanics on prepaid fees are ambiguous — the Order Form says "no refunds" but we need a clear pro-rata approach and explicit wind-down assistance (data handover and 3rd-party transition support).

Can you confirm Redwood's position on: a) increasing the cap or adding breach carve-outs; b) whether wind-down assistance can be scoped (days / $ cap); and c) a standard proration formula for prepaid credits? We need clarity to move this to procurement.

Thanks — Amit
Amit Sharma
Dir. Partnerships, Nimbus Health
[Attachment: Nimbus_MSARedline_v2.pdf]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Amit Sharma <amit@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Nitya Rao <nitya.rao@nimbushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — Limitation of Liability / Termination questions

Amit — appreciate the clear flags. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Rishi (legal) to propose concrete language. High level from Redwood: we don't offer open-ended carve-outs for consequential damages, but we do allow narrowly tailored exceptions for data breaches and IP infringement tied to Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct. For prepaid fees we typically offer pro-rata refunds for unused months after reconciliation; wind-down assistance is commonly provided as a limited SOW (30 days / up to 40 hours by default) or a fixed credit if longer support is required.

Proposed next steps: Rishi will provide redline text that (i) increases the LoL cap to a multiple of fees for the prior 12 months or a fixed floor, (ii) adds a limited carve-out for data-security breaches, and (iii) specifies a proration formula for prepaid fees plus an explicit wind-down assistance bucket. If that looks good we can update the Order Form and DocuSign link.

Hannah
VP, Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_Redline_hs_20261112.pdf]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Sharma <amit@nimbushealth.com>, Nitya Rao <nitya.rao@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — Limitation of Liability / Termination questions

Team / Amit — drafting suggestions below (summary + sample clauses). Please treat as a starting point.

1) Limitation of Liability (suggested):
- Cap: "Except for liability arising from Redwood's gross negligence, willful misconduct, or violation of the Data Processing Addendum, Redwood's aggregate liability for claims arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) three (3) times the fees paid or payable by Customer to Redwood under the Order Form in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, or (b) USD 250,000."
- Carve-outs: carve out liabilities for (i) breach of confidentiality/Data Processing obligations, (ii) willful misconduct, (iii) indemnity obligations, and (iv) death or bodily injury. Consequential damages remain excluded except where required by law.

2) Termination / Prepaid Fees / Wind-down assistance (suggested):
- Proration: "For prepaid subscriptions, Customer will receive a pro-rata refund for the unused portion of prepaid fees following termination, calculated as (Remaining days in subscription term / Total days in subscription term) * Prepaid fees, subject to reconciliation of usage-based charges incurred prior to termination."
- Wind-down assistance: "Redwood will provide up to 45 calendar days of wind-down assistance for data export, handover, and reasonable transition support at no additional charge, limited to a total of 80 hours unless otherwise agreed in a separate SOW. Any additional assistance will be charged at Redwood's then-current professional services rates. If Customer requests extended support, parties will execute a short SOW with defined deliverables and fees."

Rationale: the cap provides predictability while acknowledging the higher sensitivity for a healthcare partner; the increased cap + carve-outs should address Nimbus's counsel concerns. The 45-day / 80-hour wind-down is a middle ground between standard (30 days) and their ask. If Nimbus insists on 60+ days we can offer extended support as a paid SOW.

I'm attaching a marked-up MSA with the exact language for insertion and a tracked Order Form. Please review and let me know if we want to soften any of the phrasing.

Rishi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Order_Form_v3_marked.docx]
From: Nitya Rao <nitya.rao@nimbushealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 15:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — Limitation of Liability / Termination questions

Hannah / Rishi — thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposed language. Nimbus legal is generally comfortable with the three-times-fees / $250k floor for the LoL and the carve-outs you listed. Two small asks before we can circulate to Procurement: 1) increase the wind-down assistance to 60 calendar days (we have an internal migration window tied to our EHR vendor); 2) clarify that the proration occurs after usage reconciliation and that any data egress fees (if applicable) will be capped at $X (we'd like a reasonable upper bound).

If you can accept 60 days and add a short line: "Data egress fees, if any, will not exceed USD 5,000 unless expressly agreed in writing," we can move to signature this week.

Appreciate it — Nitya
Sr. Legal Counsel, Nimbus Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — Limitation of Liability / Termination questions

Quick update: Rishi and I discussed and Redwood can accept the 60 calendar day wind-down assistance and the $5,000 cap on data egress fees as a one-time concession for this deal. We'll update the MSA redline and the Order Form to reflect: (i) 3x fees / $250k floor LoL with listed carve-outs; (ii) proration formula with post-reconciliation refund; (iii) 60-day / 80-hour no-charge wind-down assistance; (iv) data egress fee cap $5,000. Marissa — please prepare the updated Order Form and DocuSign envelope (deal id NW-2026-1135). Rishi — will you confirm final redline language by EOD?

Hannah
VP, Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
